description: EXP bit-exactness probe (T-1778 round 4, exp-exact). A = a, B = EXP(a). Rows 1-30000: random a (|a| log-uniform in [1/16,708], 30% positive) whose exact 2^t (t = RN64(a*RN64(log2 e))) is within 1.5/2048 ulp of a binary64 midpoint. Rows 30001-32000: a in (-0.6931,0) where the x87 floor split (f = RN64(t+1)) and the exact t predict different results (split discriminator). Rows 32001-32100: 50 previously informative arguments from kmyst-erfc-* (EXP model mismatches), each repeated twice, to test reproducibility. Generator: inv4/exp-exact/search2.c, gen_probe.py.
